scope: Historical baseline plus completed language-independent geographic and global prominence searches. Source coverage and editorial review remain incomplete; not a complete physical mountain inventory.

queries.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q8502; wikibase:sitelinks ?count. FILTER(?count >= 20) }
SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q8072; wikibase:sitelinks ?count. FILTER(?count >= 20) }
SELECT DISTINCT ?item WHERE { ?item wdt:P2660 ?prominence; wdt:P625 ?location. FILTER(?prominence >= 1500) }
